title: Microsoft Outlook, Teams global outage exceeds 12 hours
summary: Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Copilot remained disrupted on November 13 for more than 12 hours, affecting enterprises and government agencies worldwide. Microsoft attributed the outage to a server issue, said it found no evidence of malicious activity, and reported expanding remediation with signs of stabilization. Australia, Japan, and U.S. government agencies were affected, Euronext email was disrupted, and a Taiwanese financial institution switched to fax for transaction confirmations; the report says this is Microsoft 365&\#x27;s second outage this year.
